meta_data.base_class: Check eligibility for free repair services of <products> - refers to various warranty-covered items such as electronics and home appliances.

tool_template.name: FreeRepairInquiry_<class>_service
tool_template.description: Service to inquire about free repair eligibility for a <class> under warranty.

purchase_receipt.description: The receipt number or proof of purchase document for the <class>.

customer_id.description: The unique customer ID associated with the purchase of the <class>.

warranty_check.description: Whether to perform a warranty check for the <class>.

include_support_contact.description: Whether to include contact details for customer support regarding the <class>.

issue_description.description: A brief description of the issue encountered with the <class>.

preferred_contact_method.description: Preferred method of contact for updates or inquiries about the <class> repair service. One of: 'email', 'phone', and 'text'.

service_location.description: The location where the repair service for the <class> is to be conducted, either on-site or at a service center.

preferred_service_time.description: Preferred time slot for scheduling the repair service of the <class>.

notification_preference.description: Whether to receive notifications about the repair status of the <class>.
